articles.title: Parliamentary committee adopts confirmation hearing report for Supreme Court justice nominee
articles.description: A parliamentary committee on Wednesday adopted a confirmation hearing report for Supreme Court Justice nominee Kim Sung-soo, paving the way for his appointment to the top court. articles.title: Ex-President Yoon acquitted of perjury in appellate trial
articles.description: An appellate court on Wednesday acquitted former President Yoon Suk Yeol of committing perjury during the insurrection trial of former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo.
